method: Chromium device emulation in the Claude built-in browser (resize_window; widths < 768 also emulate a touch phone). Level 2 seed 12, __boss('leader') (boss bar visible), then __hudLayout() and a screenshot. No physical device.

cinematicSkipTouch.steps: __boss('leader') with cinematics on; step 0.5 s; dispatch pointerdown (pointerType touch) on #cine; step 0.3 s
cinematicSkipTouch.note: A tap at t < 0.3 s is ignored by design (grace period)

audioInterruptions.steps: game.audio.init(); ctx.resume(); game.pause(); game.resume(); audio.toggleMute() x2 (gain values read after each step)
audioInterruptions.routing: music bus -> game bus -> master, so pause also silences music
audioInterruptions.verdict: PASS (gain level only; not checked by ear; tab-hidden suspend path not exercised)
